description: Read an eCFR section (FDA, OSHA, EPA). Use this when the user asks what a specific US federal regulation says, including an FDA, OSHA, EPA, SEC, FTC or FAA section of the eCFR, for example "what does 21 CFR 11.10 say?", "read 29 CFR 1910.134" or "show me 17 CFR 240.10b-5". Pass the CFR title number and the section number. Returns the current text, heading, statutory authority and amendment history of the section, the date the eCFR is up to date as of and a link to it. A very long section is cut and flagged. This is general information, not legal advice. Do not use it to find a regulation by topic (use search_cfr), for statutes, state law or court decisions, or to decide whether someone complies.

section.description: Section number as written in the citation, without the section sign: "11.10", "240.10b-5" or "1910.134".

title.description: CFR title number, 1 to 50: for example 21 is Food and Drugs, 29 Labor, 17 Securities, 40 Environment, 14 Aeronautics.
